subject: Social Media
title: Dumbphones and Digital Minimalism
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Dumbphones and Digital Minimalism.

hook.text: Sales of 'dumbphones'—basic phones without apps—grew 25% in 2023. People are buying boring on purpose.

buildup.text: Cal Newport's digital minimalism: use only the tech that serves your values. Delete everything else.

discovery.text: Minimalists report better sleep, deeper focus, and richer in-person relationships within weeks.

twist.text: It's a privilege. Many jobs require constant connectivity. Opting out of social media means opting out of opportunities.

climax.text: The middle path: keep the tools, change the defaults. No notifications, no home screen apps, scheduled checks.

punchline.text: The radical act isn't quitting. It's choosing.

quiz.question: What is Cal Newport's digital minimalism approach?
options: Use only technology that serves your values
